settings.note: Pooled out-of-fold predictions (187 isolates x 3 repeats = 561 rows). Isolate bootstrap: isolates resampled with replacement, the three rows of an isolate share the resample weight; the same 1000 resamples are used for all methods and models. Calibration intercept: logistic model with logit(p) as offset (slope fixed at 1); slope: logistic model y ~ a + b logit(p) (joint_intercept is a). ECE bins are fixed from the full pooled set. Cross-fitted threshold: MCC-maximizing threshold on the 0.01 grid chosen on the pooled predictions of the other two repeats (median of ties); the labels of the isolates to which it is applied are therefore seen through other repeats' predictions, a limitation of a design without a held-out split.
